The *Māradheyya Sutta* ("Māra’s Sway", Iti 59, It 3.10, PTS It 50) is an early Buddhist discourse belonging to the *Itivuttaka* [SuttaCentral]. In this brief discourse, the Buddha sets forth three qualities that lead beyond Māra’s sway or realm (*māradheyya*) [SuttaCentral]. On SuttaCentral, the text is translated into modern English by Bhikkhu Sujato, alongside 19 translations across 17 languages [SuttaCentral].
